thread:
tim_parks: heads-up — CloudNexus marketplace goes live next week. we need a lightweight partner SEV path focused on fast triage and minimal noise. thinking a temporary 'sentinel' channel + tiger-team flow for the first 72h. open to suggestions. :mag:

maria_k: agree on 'sentinel' language. single triage channel pinned with clear roles will help. avoid spinning up multiple bridges unless it's a true P0.

alex_chen: suggested channel: `#partner-sentinel-cloudnexus` 1 pinned runbook + single escalation bridge for P0 only. keeps search simple.

chris_sre: +1. recommend we include quick SRE commands in the pinned runbook and a short PD escalation snippet so partner engineers know the paging rules.

jen_support: we should add a 4-step header checklist for first responders: 1) confirm partner request id, 2) assign tiger lead, 3) call partner POC, 4) escalate to liaison/oncall if no ack in 30m.

leo_partner_eng: CloudNexus requests their SI and integration PM be present in the channel. they also want an explicit contact matrix (partner_poc, si_lead, redwood_liaison).

chris_sre: proposed escalation model:
```
- P3/P2: triage in channel, notify partner_poc, target TTR same business day
- P1 (degradation): tiger team in channel + SRE involvement, 30m ack target
- P0 (outage/breakglass): spin dedicated bridge, PD page to SRE+partner oncall, exec escalate if >60m
```

tim_parks: for PD paging do we page partner oncall directly or run it through our liaison first?

jen_support: liaison-first for initial 2h window, then auto-forward to partner oncall if unresolved. keeps partner noise limited for transient issues.

alex_chen: operational note: provision a short-lived shared AWS role in our vault for the SI with minimal rights and a rotation plan. link that in the runbook so we don't exchange creds ad-hoc.

leo_partner_eng: CloudNexus OK with shared role approach. I'll coordinate token rotation schedule and DM the creds owner.

chris_sre: things to pin in the channel: runbook, PD snippet, shared role/vault pointer, postmortem template, quickchecks (kubectl/curl). sample PD msg format: `PD: P0 CloudNexus - ingress latency - svc/edge - https://incident/XXXX`

oncall-bot: reminders configured: 30m acknowledgement check, 2h liaison check-in, 24h post-summary. use `/oncall escalate` to page PD.

maria_k: launch-day checklist (I will own): 1) create `#partner-sentinel-cloudnexus` 2) invite partner_poc + SI lead 3) pin artifacts 4) schedule 15m syncs at 10:00 and 16:00 for first 72h 5) draft rollback triggers for known failure modes.

tim_parks: tasks: maria create channel & post runbook; alex/chris add SRE PD snippet + commands; leo add partner SI contacts; jen prepare liaison rotation. I'll prepare a one-paragraph exec comms template for P0. :thumbsup:

alex_chen: will add quick `kubectl -n cloudnexus` commands and `curl` health checks to runbook.

chris_sre: added SRE checklist: `check kv cache`, `describe svc/ingress`, `tail -n 200 app logs -l app=cloudnexus`.

leo_partner_eng: CloudNexus PM and SI lead invited to channel, they asked for a dry-run of the PD flow this afternoon.

jen_support: liaison rota posted: maria -> jen -> tim for initial 36h; then hand off to support oncall.

maria_k: channel created and pinned runbook + vault links. scheduling dry-run at 15:30 PT, open invite for observers.

tim_parks: drop a :eyes: if you can join 15:30. we'll simulate PD and validate paging and reminders.

alex_chen: :eyes: I'll simulate PD and validate pages.

jen_support: :eyes:

chris_sre: :eyes:

leo_partner_eng: CloudNexus SI will join dry-run.

oncall-bot: dry-run reminder set for 15:30 PT.

maria_k: great work, everyone. i'll post a short summary and any adjustments after the dry-run. closing thread.
